scope.indexRequirement: valid zero-based index into the pinned desktop-6.4.4 monster table
scope.stateRequirement: otherwise supported; no legacy prologue, unsupported fTask, or other substantive adaptation

sourceSemantics.newCharacter: GoButtonClick clears fQuest.Caption before creating the initial prologue queue.
sourceSemantics.loadSave: LoadGame restores component properties through ReadComponent without quest-marker normalization; SaveGame serializes the component stream.
sourceSemantics.monsterQuest: CompleteQuest's Exterminate branch stores the selected monster-table row in fQuest.Caption and its zero-based row index in fQuest.Tag. Non-monster branches clear the caption.
sourceSemantics.markerUse: MonsterTask tests only whether fQuest.Caption is non-empty before its one-in-four quest-monster choice, then selects K.Monsters.Lines[fQuest.Tag].
sourceSemantics.candidateCanonicalValue: The monster-table row at the saved index; it is not inferred from fQuest's placeholder spelling.

checks: canonical state after the existing task-completion marker resolution
subsequent quest/task transitions and desktop random-state consumption
unsigned request construction for all five operation shapes

boundaryChecks.legacyPrologueAndCombinedAdaptations: remain outside the passing import path and production gates

excluded: fTask captions and unsupported task forms
unknown captions other than the exact fQuest placeholder
real saves, credentials, signed requests, live acceptance, and active-time evidence

decision.review: The exact indexed-placeholder source behavior and local synthetic equivalence are supported. Official LoadGame does not normalize the marker; canonical-state equality occurs through the existing native task-completion resolution, not import-time provenance erasure. This does not establish Delphi component-stream runtime equivalence, save-writer identity, or a general adaptation exemption.
